positions.title: Senior AI Frameworks Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to post-training and fine-tuning efforts using Intel® AI PC hardware to fine-tune Llama 3 8B with Unsloth and GRPO-based QLoRA reinforcement learning on the PubMedQA dataset. Conducted controlled experiments to evaluate and optimize hyperparameters and training configurations within local hardware constraints. Subsequently, evaluated multi-agent frameworks and developed proof-of-concept implementations for a multi-agent Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) reinforcement learning use case, analyzing design tradeoffs, coordination strategies, and alignment performance.

Collaborated with a small engineering team to design and implement a multimodal RAG chatbot leveraging a Redis vector store populated with video, PDF, image, audio, and text data. Authored a comprehensive RFC detailing the software architecture and phased development plan, incorporating Docker-based services including data ingestion, retrieval, and large vision model (LVM) querying. Led the on-schedule delivery of all three development phases. Co-authored a published blog promoting the chatbot’s capabilities using Intel® Gaudi® AI accelerators.

positions.title: Senior Deep Learning Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the team working on the Intel AI Reference Model open source repository (https://github.com/intel/ai-reference-models). Ensured that the scripts the repository would allow users to run models using the best known configuration on Intel hardware. Coordinated with developers from multiple geos who were contributing to the repository to ensure consistency across the repo and communicate code structure, standards, and release deadlines.

Served as the lead architect and developer for the Intel Transfer Learning Tool (https://github.com/intel/transfer-learning) which provided a consistent API and CLI for training and inference on Intel hardware using models from a variety of model hubs (PyTorch hub, Keras, TorchVision, Hugging Face Hub, TensorFlow Hub, etc). Wrote a design document, created a proof-of-concept, and coordinated the development effort with the team. Presented and demoed the tool to our organization to receive feedback, then worked with a smaller set of data scientist of find out the biggest pain points to tackle. Worked with UX engineers to get usability feedback from external AI engineers, and then used that information to make improvements.

Worked on open source contributions to the ecosystem for features related to distributed training, Kubernetes, and Slurm when using Intel hardware. Specific contributions include enabling multi-node CPU jobs in the Hugging Face Accelerate launch CLI using mpirun, developing a single/multi card helm chart to deploy Hugging Face optimum-habana examples to Kubernetes clusters with Gaudi, and adding an multi-node CPU Kubernetes training example to Hugging Face Transformers. Published a blog to Hugging Face featuring a distributed Llama 2 LLM fine tuning workflow. Helped to ramp 2 other engineers on using containers, Kubernetes and Slurm to enable their contributions to the ecosystem.

positions.title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the Nervana Cloud team developing a REST API and CLI used for deploying TensorFlow and neon training and inference jobs to the cloud.

Served as a lead developer for the Machine Learning Templates (MLT) open source tool, which provided templates and a CLI to make it easier to deploy ML/DL jobs to Kubernetes clusters. Created a distributed workflow using MLT to train UNet with the Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) dataset to detect tumors in brain scan images. Wrote a blog highlighting the use of MLT with the UNet training workflow to demonstrate the use of the tool while visualizing the model training using TensorBoard.

positions.title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed backend libraries as part of Intel Trusted Analysis Platform (TAP) project. Contributed to the Analytics Tooklit (ATK) open source product and helped rearchitect and implement the next generation Spark Toolkit (spark-tk) library. These scala and python libraries abstracted out the complexities of running machine learning jobs and provided enhanced capabilities needed for TAP projects.

Presented at Spark Summit 2017 demonstrating the use of spark-tk with other products in the ecosystem to do distributed end-to-end drug similarity analytics and visualization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project managed and led development planning for JTAG-based run control, breakpoint management, memory access and register access solution in the Intel® Open IPC Debug Library.  Received high-level design from the software architect and broke down work into development phases, milestones, and scrum stories, along with effort estimates.  Held weekly sync meeting with developers in Germany, as this project was a development collaboration between two groups.  Primary languages: C++ 11, Python, XML.

Worked on the design and development for the Target Manager module in the Intel® Open IPC Debug Library.  Module is used for discovering devices on the system, and managing JTAG controllers and test access ports, which allow higher level APIs to execute commands to the system under test.  Served as Scrum Master for the Open IPC development team.  Primary languages: C++ 11, Python, XML.

Architected, designed user interface, and developed source code debug and run control plugin to the Intel® Platform Debug Toolkit (PDT).  Features are used by BIOS engineers and post-silicon validation test developers.  Worked with the lead software architect to develop the Intel® PDT’s framework using Microsoft PRISM.  Served as a key contact and in-lab customer support at new processor power-on events.  Responsible for planning and code reviewing scrum sprint work for the small team of engineers.  Primary languages: C# (using WPF/XAML), XML.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a team to prototype and develop a tree-based data storage solution used for holding and decorating large amounts of data.  Solution was used as a foundation class in the Intel® In-Target Probe (ITP) II software stack.  Primary languages: C#, XML.

Contributed to the development of a micro-architectural debug tool, used by post-silicon validators to configure processor debug hooks and dump the state of the processor.  Served as team lead, developer, key customer support contact, code reviewer, and scrum master.  Also responsible for performing validation and posting releases.  Primary languages: C#, XML.

Worked with a development team to create an application used for viewing and debugging Intel® QuickPath Interconnect transactions.  Served as the owner and primary developer of the application’s display module.  Primary languages: VB, C++.

Designed and developed applications and web tools used for charting post-silicon validation metrics, triaging bugs found during processor validation, and managing quarterly objectives for the organization.  Primary languages: C#/VB .NET, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, T-SQL.

positions.description: Freelance web developer for Northwest Alpacas.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Designed and developed web tool used for graphing manufacturing test yields.  Primary languages and technologies: HTML, CSS, Javascript, PHP, ChartDirector (PHP extension), and MySQL.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: Assisted webmaster with website redesign using DotNetNuke.  Created skin for the redesigned website, met with staff members to discuss web content, created animated slideshows using Flash, and used SQL Server to store information on employment opportunities being displayed online.
